Full text readable; Appendix E (ordinances) and the Spending Plan are not in the text, so zones have density/set-aside only (no bulk standards). Combined Prior+Third Round: obligation 354, RDP 24 met by M&D Two (6), Mumford (12), Borrie Ave (2), Municipal Building (5) = 25; unmet need 330 via Higgins Avenue Corridor Redevelopment (16-18 du/ac) and MSO. Round 4: prospective need 65, RDP 0, unmet need 65 via Route 71 Overlay (10-12 du/ac) and Brielle Sports Club overlay (65.01:8, 18.8 du/ac, added by 12/30/25 FSHC settlement). No separate prior-round credit sites listed. RDP-basis-only VLA parcels (11:9 616 Union Ave; 104.01:7.02 and 120:13.01,15 Route 70/Tamarack Dr) not recorded; Hightide Brielle builder's remedy site (77.01:4,5, 403 Higgins Ave; in negotiation, to be folded into the Higgins Ave redevelopment plan) not recorded as a site. Skipped: rehab (0), dev-fee ordinance, affordable housing ordinance. Plan pages are printed page numbers. First Brielle extraction.

St. Francis site (Block 50002 Lot 1.03, 17.66 ac, agreed 12 du/ac / 40 affordable) generates RDP but is not in the compliance table, so not recorded. 370 Morris affordable count given as 24 in one sentence and 10 elsewhere; used 10.
